stem.text: The graph shows the $I$–$V$ characteristic for a semiconductor diode.

stem.alt: Graph of I against V for a semiconductor diode, with a curve passing through the origin and continuing into the lower left, with the axes labelled I and V.

stem.text: Which statement can be deduced from the graph?

A.text: Above a certain positive potential difference the diode obeys Ohm’s law.

B.text: Current is directly proportional to potential difference when the current in the diode is in one direction.

C.text: The diode has zero resistance when the current in the diode is in one direction.

D.text: The resistance of the diode depends upon the potential difference across it.
